initialization: normal: hidden sqrt(2/fan_in); output sqrt(1/fan_in); zero biases; independent block seeds

quadrature.failure: record failure; stop stage; never relax

analysis.contrast: structured - direct; mean four families within seed, by n
analysis.missing_nonfinite: retain and report; no complete-case confirmatory inference
analysis.calibration: ECE 10 equal-width bins; independent observed rewards
analysis.local_excess: FP64 integrated KL and half squared posterior error; first 256 held-out contexts, both actions
analysis.secondary: value excess BCE/MSE, best-action classification, decision regret, calibration, boundary, local excess, error correlation, kappa, timings
analysis.attribution: same checkpoint d1,d2,probability average; independent ensemble; separate training costs
